messages.subject: Confidence interval DEB and DEB_euler
parts:
Hi,

I am using the Dynamic Energy Budget model in aquaculture and I have a question about the DEB and DEB_euler fonctions from the NicheMapR package. What are the margins of error of their outputs ? I would indeed be interested to know what are the confidence intervals of each parameter in the final "debout" file.

Thank you for your time,
Léanne

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: Confidence interval DEB and DEB_euler
parts:
Hi Léanne,

The model is fully deterministic so there is no error on the outputs in the 'debout' matrix. The input parameters from the 'AmP' collection do not have confidence intervals but see here for how you can calculate them in the context of the DEB parameter estimation process. If you have estimates of uncertainty in your parameters (or were treating them as genetically variable, or phenotypically plastic) you could run simulations that incorporate that uncertainty and then produce outputs with means and confidence intervals.

All the best,
Mike
